body:
# ReaLeaves - Enhanced Leaf Textures 🌿

Transform your Minecraft forests with ReaLeaves, a texture pack that breathes life into every leaf block! This pack upgrades default foliage with richer colors, improved transparency, and layered depth — making trees look lush, organic, and immersive.

# Features:
- High-resolution leaf textures with subtle shading and detail
- Improved transparency for a more natural, airy look
- Dynamic color variation for biome-specific realism
- Compatible with vanilla and most shaders

Perfect for builders, explorers, and nature lovers who want their landscapes to feel alive. ReaLeaves brings the forest to life — one pixel at a time 🍃
